question: Should OpenClaw accept native compaction results produced during the bounded timeout-cancellation commit window, instead of treating every timeout-aborted compaction as failed?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but it changes session-state semantics at the timeout boundary and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout progress
options.body: Merge after maintainer review if the WeakSet-scoped timeout reason and microtask commit window are the intended policy for preserving useful compaction progress.

options.title: Require stricter timeout failure semantics
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves inner timeout partial summaries and timeout copy but keeps timeout-aborted native compaction results from committing after cancellation.

options.title: Pause for a larger design
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want persistent checkpoints, per-stage budgets, or a different compaction architecture instead of the bounded commit-window approach.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout progress
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review if the WeakSet-scoped timeout reason and microtask commit window are the intended policy for preserving useful compaction progress.
